additional_info.subject: 0470185 - ID0470185-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/R7 170002200] Charger B3, B4 not working CRM:00314000250
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0470185.
The ticket has been opened for charger
MP/R7 170002200,
which has outlet DC3 and DC4 of dispenser not working.
I checked the charger on SCB, and there are several error flags active:
I tried a reboot of the charger, but it did not solve the issue. Even if at first glance it seems that the charger is not able to allocate power converters and complete the fastshutdown, as if the State Monitor of Dispenser KF214 is not working, I connected via SSH to the charger and discovered that:
There is communication to Dispenser PLC
There is no communication to the 2 EcoGs of Dispenser
There is no communication to the 2 LEM meters of the Dispenser.
I believe the dispenser is powered off. I suspect that the fuses FC212 and FC213 of the dispenser are tripped. Therefore, it is necessary to go onsite and troubleshoot the charger.
I checked the charger in our ISP asset, and the charger is
out of warranty.
For this reason, I am
moving the case
0470185
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue
.

eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: 0470185 - ID0470185-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/R7 170002200] Charger B3, B4 not working CRM:00314000250
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
Thank you for the feedback! I took a look right now again to the charger, and :
EcoG KF211 (DC3) is reachable
EcoG KF212 (DC4( is unreachable
Both outlets cannot perform fastshutdown
DC3 has an error flag on cable temperature sensor.
At the moment, without an onsite visit, it is not possible for me to assess what the issue is. It is necessary to go onsite and verify:
If EcoG KF212 has a problem. I recommend to bring onsite a spare one
The fastshutdown and cable temperature issue could come from an issue on the State Monitor KF214. I recommend to bring onsite a spare one.
General troubleshooting of the dispenser, to understand if the issue is generated by a lack of 24V, false contact, ETH communication, etc.
Please organize an onsite visit with a spare KF212 and KF214. If you need support form our side, please send an invitation via ExpertNow Service.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
With kind regards,
